suiteQualification: The hosted Node 24 gate is the unit-suite authority (#198). Local whole-suite failures remain FAIL and need per-failure classification; no environmental exception promotes an item to PASS.

items.title: Fresh permission onboarding: OWNER revocation, model errors, staged grants and relaunch recovery

checks.name: preconditions
checks.detail: approved engine verified; no live engine connection or TextEdit to disturb

checks.name: owner revocation
checks.detail: owner confirmed at the terminal (revoked); not performed by automation

checks.name: Accessibility error reaches the model
checks.detail: MCP js error names Accessibility, + and the exact approved bundle path

checks.name: all three grants absent
checks.detail: Accessibility, Screen Recording and Input Monitoring read false

checks.name: owner Accessibility grant
checks.detail: owner confirmed at the terminal (granted); not performed by automation

checks.name: Screen Recording error reaches the model
checks.detail: MCP js error names Screen Recording, +, exact approved path and pending relaunch

checks.name: AX-only intervention diagnostic
checks.detail: with AX alone granted, doctor reports Input Monitoring absent and intervention detection off

checks.name: owner Screen Recording grant
checks.detail: owner confirmed at the terminal (granted); not performed by automation

checks.name: service relaunch recovery
checks.detail: same MCP connection recovered; engine PID changed during retry and screenshot bytes were nonempty (not emitted)

checks.name: owner capture confirmation observation
checks.detail: owner confirmed at the terminal (none); not performed by automation

checks.name: intervention off
checks.detail: input must attest intervention off, and doctor must say detection is off while Input Monitoring is absent

evidence.ownerWindow: 9 minutes continuously for item 14, inside the combined 12-minute owner window with the separate foreground trial: remove the three entries and open a blank TextEdit document (3); grant Accessibility (1); grant Screen Recording, choosing Later, and answer any capture confirmation (2); grant Input Monitoring (1); finish approval/checks and quit TextEdit without saving (2).
